name: protocol_eval_v2_amendment1
date: 2026-11-14 (Sat, KST ~21:25), written BEFORE any val2 tile is scored; amends configs/protocol_eval_v2.json (hash ccbb4338cd536bff) after the night-fire tile set was built
primary_validation: val2 (114 pairs / 57 fire episodes / 3,743 night tiles, 0 tiles within 60 km of any v3 val/test tile, no episode crossing train/val2) becomes the PRIMARY validation. The old 16-pair night validation (12-15 qualifying pairs) is SECONDARY and marked tuning-contaminated.
region_balanced_statistic: the primary number is a REGION-BALANCED mean: AUC per scene pair as in protocol v2 (complete 3x3 blocks, rule truth on measured VIIRS, >= 10 fire / >= 100 other blocks); within a region the mean over EPISODES (pairs of one episode averaged first); then the plain mean over regions with >= 2 qualifying episodes. Regions = the pipeline's region labels (Australia, Borneo, mainland SE Asia, others as labelled in manifest.parquet); a region with fewer than 2 qualifying episodes is listed but not averaged. Australia therefore carries one region's weight, not 95 % of the fire.
uncertainty: episode-clustered bootstrap within each region (4,000 resamples), regions fixed; the decision rule of protocol v2 (gain >= 0.05, range above 0, positive in >= 75 % of qualifying EPISODES) applies to the region-balanced difference; every claim states the number of independent episodes (not pairs, not blocks) and per-region results are shown with no pass/fail
also_report: per region and per split: complete 3x3 blocks, fire blocks, fire-level cells (own counters, not the builder's), qualifying episodes
Southeast Asian regions (Borneo, mainland SE Asia, Sumatra if labelled) separately because the target use is Indonesia
val2 scored once per setting with the FINAL epoch; no selection on val2
training_switch: region-balanced sampling (tiles weighted so every region contributes equally per epoch) is an on/off switch; the question answered is whether Australian savanna fires help or hurt the Southeast Asian regions
status_when_written: no val2 score computed yet; packing of the final night-fire sets pending (only early/ packs exist and must not be used)
